assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE exact 3-column by 3-row atlas of nine independent square scenes with cream gutters at the exact thirds. Original first-grade story illustrations, matte gouache, fine paper grain, cut-paper edges, pine green and warm cream, persimmon and apricot. No letters, numerals, markings, labels, speech bubbles or textbook figures. Reuse two friends from the last row of the supplied reference only: short-haired 7-year-old girl in orange with cream collar and slightly taller same-age friend in pine green with a green hair bow. EXHIBIT scenes read left to right: top row (1) on the left a small sturdy open wooden crate with two handles and a few paper props rests on a low cream exhibit table, while the orange girl points to an empty cabinet on the right, green friend looks carefully; (2) both children safely hold opposite handles of the same small crate from the first tile, one child each end, both hands secure, stable upright box, no wheeled cart; (3) same two children push a stable low wheeled utility cart carrying the same upright wood crate, no lifting, wheels visible, body of cart clear. Middle row, use very simple close-up matching perspective and identical three hollow rolled paper tubes colored apricot, cream and pine: (4) two hands move a shallow wood tray with raised rim on every visible edge, three tubes stay contained with their open circular ends visible; (5) two hands hold a flat rimless thin platter at a slant and at least one paper tube rolls off the edge, open ends visible; (6) a girl tries to cradle the same three paper tubes in bare hands, one visibly slips downward, no tray or box. Bottom row: (7) child orange girl and warm adult mother in dark green sit together at home by window, one large picture book open between them with blank parchment pages, child points at a particular place and looks up with a questioning expression, mother leaning in to listen; (8) same child reads an open blank book alone at a small table while adult is far in background occupied by a kettle; (9) same mother beside child, book shut on table, child now absorbed examining a paper lantern they are holding and looks away from mother. Each independent scene fills its own tile without crop, restrained quiet background, immediately obvious body language, no clutter.
